figurative_meaning_bn: যাকে দিয়ে ইচ্ছা মতো কাজ করানো যায়
figurative_meaning_en: Someone who can be manipulated or controlled to do one's bidding
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার স্ত্রীর হাতের পুতুল হয়ে গেছে।
রাজনীতিতে অনেক নেতা দলীয় প্রধানের হাতের পুতুল।
example_sentences_in_english: He has become a puppet in his wife's hands.
In politics, many leaders are puppets of the party chief.
history: In the colonial era (পরাধীন আমল), many political leaders were puppets in the hands of British rulers (ইংরাজ শাসক).
note: This idiom often carries connotations of loss of autonomy in power dynamics.
